shortDescription: Spain's seasonally- and calendar-adjusted industrial output rose 2.3% in July from the same month a year earlier, official data from the country's National Statistics Institute (INE) showed on Thursday.The year-on-year growth in July followed a 1.1% expansion in June.

The year-on-year growth in July followed a 1.1% expansion in June.
